description: One check-in event at the door: a QR scan, a manual name-list admit, a cash sale, or a comp. Written by the scanner device, possibly offline, and uploaded with a nonce so replays are idempotent. The reconciliation sheet is computed from these.

ticket.description: Absent for cash and walk-up admits with no ticket.

scannerId.description: Stable id of the scanning device or operator.

nonce.description: Unique per scan; the server ignores a second upload with the same nonce.

cashCollected.description: Set on cashAdmit. Feeds the deposit total.

offline.description: True if the scanner had no connection to the hub or server at the moment of the scan.
